findings.finding: The three Q3 monthly statistics releases put brokerage-generating turnover at about SEK 347bn over 66 trading days (vs 367bn in Q2), with notes/day down ~23% q/q and foreign share ~31%. At Q2's ~11bp gross yield that implies net brokerage of about SEK 324m, against the 323m consensus. The trading-activity line is pre-released and in the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 brokerage 349 vs 340 est with op profit beat -> stock -0.7% on the day (Modular table)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The monthly statistics are public and the 18-analyst consensus (brokerage 323m) already matches the turnover arithmetic. Pareto's preview names 'lower trading activity' explicitly. Filed at 0 to record that the main revenue line holds no surprise.
findings.independence: Pareto preview 2026-10-12, 'lägre handelsaktivitet vägs upp av högre räntenetto': https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012

findings.finding: Avanza's own 2026 cost guide (+9% ex-expansion on the 2025 base of SEK 1,413m, plus SEK 50m Denmark, of which only 3m was booked in H1) implies H2 ex-expansion costs of about SEK 760m (+4.7% y/y after H1's +14%). If Q3 takes its usual ~45% share of H2, Q3 costs are about 340m ex-Denmark, or ~355-365m with a partial Denmark charge, against the -373m consensus. That is roughly a 10-15m (1-1.5%) op-profit upside if the guide is held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4-24: costs 335 vs 338 est and FY cost growth below guide, with an op-profit beat -> +13.1%. Q2-26: costs 406 vs 398 est (above) inside a beat -> -0.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at -373m equals Q3-25 (324m) x 1.09 plus about 20m of Denmark. That is +9% on the quarter, not the +4.7% H2 run-rate the full-year guide implies after a +14% H1. If analysts had taken the guide at face value the Q3 cost line would read nearer 360m. The other reading is that analysts expect a guide overshoot. That is the downside branch and the reason the range is wide.
findings.independence: Pareto (2026-10-12) says its 2026 cost forecast is 'i linje med bolagets guidning'. The same source agrees the guide is the reference, but it does not resolve the quarterly phasing: https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012

findings.finding: Analysts have under-forecast Avanza's net interest income in recent beats: Q2-26 486 vs 454 est, Q4-24 385 vs 365. Pareto raised 2027-28 EPS 4% on higher NII three days before the print. Against that, the monthly statistics show average customer deposits down ~3.5% q/q (Q2 ~118.8bn to Q3 ~114.6bn) while internal lending rose ~10.5% (30.2bn to 33.4bn) with the policy rate flat at 1.75%. My volume arithmetic lands near the 473m bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2-26 NII +32m beat inside a 4.4% op-profit beat -> -0.7%. Q4-24 NII +20m beat inside a 7% beat -> +13.1%.
findings.original_quote: Räntenettot blev 486 miljoner kronor jämfört med analytikersnittet på 454 miljoner kronor.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus 473m is below Q2's 486m on flat rates and +10% lending. The bar already carries a deposit-driven decline, and a repeat of the under-forecast is not in it. If the market priced the habit, the bar would sit at or above Q2. It is partly offset by the public deposit decline, so it is sized small as an inference.
findings.independence: Pareto 2026-10-12, 'höjer vinstprognoserna för 2027 och 2028 med 4 procent vardera, drivet av högre räntenetto': https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza-bank-pareto-hojer-riktkursen-for-avanza-till-450-kronor-upprepar-kop-20261012.
